title: Account deletion is deliberate and complete
shows: Deletion needs the exact phrase and an acknowledgement. Afterwards the old session is dead, C's data is gone and A's data is untouched.
limits: Local stack. Composio is a local mock reporting no connections, as in the deletion design evidence. Provider-held copies and backups are outside this test.
